text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm at the school store with Sakura Chiyono O…
choice_data_list: Are you looking to buy origami paper?
Are you looking to buy origami paper?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I am! I want to try making some origami.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I recently received a fan letter that came with an origami cherry blossom. I could tell how much feeling the sender put into it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to fold something for them too when I write a reply back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm just a regular Umamusume… There's nothing spectacular about me that would catch anyone's eye.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But still… there are people out there cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Their words are so kind, it makes me want to cry when I read them… They warm my heart and make the fire in me burn brighter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It all just feels like a dream.
choice_data_list: So what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I… I want to live up to their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to show my gratitude to my supporters. I want to make the people cheering for me happy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to gift them my smile… A smile as beautiful as a flower in bloom!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll become a flower as beautiful as the origami cherry blossom I received!
choice_data_list: Then for starters, you'd better send that reply.
Then for starters, you'd better send that reply.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm thinking of sending them an even bigger origami cherry blossom in return!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That way, they'll know I'm going to bloom into a huge flower!
